items.title: ‘Unwelcome and unsafe’: Why Japanese companies are retreating from China at a historic rate
items.title_zh: ‘Unwelcome and unsafe’: Why Japanese companies are retreating from China at a historic rate
items.summary: 未调用大模型，以下为原文关键信息摘录：Japanese companies are leaving China in record numbers, as a slowing Chinese economy and a diplomatic freeze force businesses to reassess their presence in the world's second-largest economy.；The number of Japanese companies operating in China fell to a historic low, standing at 10,118 as of June, according to Teikoku Databank, a corporate credit research firm in Japan.；That's down 22% from the previous survey held in June 2024 and about 30% below the 2012 peak, and the lowest since Teikoku began tracking the data in 2010.
important_points: Japanese companies are leaving China in record numbers, as a slowing Chinese economy and a diplomatic freeze force businesses to reassess their presence in the world's second-largest economy.
The number of Japanese companies operating in China fell to a historic low, standing at 10,118 as of June, according to Teikoku Databank, a corporate credit research firm in Japan.
That's down 22% from the previous survey held in June 2024 and about 30% below the 2012 peak, and the lowest since Teikoku began tracking the data in 2010.

important_points: Supreme Court Justice Samuel Alito has "thought about" retiring after the high court's last term but decided against it, believing he could still make "a valuable contribution," he said in an interview with CBS News.
